post.summary: Screen subjects against Entity Lists (Match Scores; persists nothing)
post.description: SCREENING-1. Read-shaped (CapabilityManifest exemption): scores each subject's name (folded, look-alike letters mapped, token-set Jaro-Winkler) and identifier (exact under the list's sealed normaliser, prefix/range/CIDR) against the named Entity Lists; returns matches at or above the threshold, best first. A POST so names never ride in a URL. A retired list matches nothing; an expired entry never matches; a masked list's entry is its mask token.

schema.description: {subjects[1..1000]: [{key?, name?, identifier?}], lists[1..20]: [listId], threshold? (0.5..1, default 0.85), maxMatches? (1..20, default 5)}

200.description: Envelope-wrapped: data = {threshold, results[{key, name, identifier, matches[{listId, purpose, entry, method (name|identifier), score}]}]}

422.description: Malformed body, or an unknown Entity List.

get.description: SCREENING-1. Hits raised by screening.run Jobs. Optional query 'state' = open|escalated|confirmed|dismissed. A record that fails its integrity check is listed with integrity: invalid.

200.description: Envelope-wrapped: data = {hits[{id, state, version, listId, purpose, entry, method, score, threshold, subjectKey, subjectName, subjectIdentifier, source, raisedAt, raisedBy, decidedBy?, decidedAt?, reason?, history[]}]}

post.summary: Decide a Screening Hit (confirm, dismiss or escalate)
post.description: SCREENING-1. Gated on canWorkIncidents. open -> confirmed|dismissed|escalated; escalated -> confirmed|dismissed; confirmed and dismissed are final. The body names the hit's current version (optimistic concurrency) and a reason; the transition is appended to the hit's history and audited (never the screened name).

schema.description: {decision: confirm|dismiss|escalate, reason (1..500), version (the hit's current version)}

409.description: Stale version, a final state, a transition not allowed, or a record that failed its integrity check.
